tasks_completed.description: AC7 — trip_total aggregate recompute on any save touching budget data
tasks_completed.rationale: Added recompute_trip_total() in scripts/lib/semantic_lint.py and wired it via _maybe_recompute_trip_total() into _prepare_agent_data() so every save_single_agent() invocation with agent='budget' (whatever the cause: budget-agent re-save, or budget data touched indirectly via the merge slot path) recomputes data.trip_total = sum(data.days[].budget.total). Verified live on data/china-20260412-092624/budget.json: pre-save trip_total=23416 vs sum=13044 (stale); post-save trip_total=13044 == sum=13044. Stderr audit line: '[save] trip_total recomputed: 13044 (sum of days[].budget.total)'. Original budget.json restored after live verification.

tasks_completed.description: AC8 — cross-domain dedup WARN with optional --strict-dedup BLOCK escalation
tasks_completed.rationale: Added check_cross_domain_dedup() in semantic_lint.py covering attractions/shopping/entertainment as POI_FLAT_DOMAINS. Compares each item's normalized name_base AND name_local against an index of the other two domains' existing same-day items. Wired into save_single_agent() via _run_pre_save_checks() → _run_cross_domain_dedup_check(). Default WARN level emits to stderr without aborting; --strict-dedup CLI flag escalates to BLOCK (save returns False, exit 1). v1 shape-agnostic normalizer is whitespace-stripped lower-case; W8 will provide canonical _normalize_to_canonical_record() that this v1 can be upgraded to call. Verified live with seeded duplicate 'Wukang Road & Anfu Road' on Day 12 — WARN emitted; --strict-dedup escalated to BLOCK + exit 1; also surfaced a real pre-existing duplicate '新天地' Day 13 (attractions vs shopping).

tasks_completed.description: AC9 — demoted-primary state machine: drop old primary unless explicitly listed
tasks_completed.rationale: Added audit_demoted_primaries() in semantic_lint.py. For each meal_slot whose existing primary differs from update primary, AND whose old primary is NOT explicitly listed (by normalized name) in incoming alternatives[], emit stderr audit line: '[save] demoted-primary policy: Day {N} {meal}: dropped "{old-primary-name}"; retained alternatives: [{list}]'. Save does NOT auto-preserve the old primary — the existing merge_agent_slots() does whole-slot replacement, so the old primary disappears unless the agent explicitly retained it. Wired via _emit_demoted_primary_audit_for_meals() in _merge_existing_slots() (called only when agent_file.stem == 'meals'). Verified live with two payloads: (a) replace Day 12 lunch primary with new item + empty alternatives → audit line emitted, saved file shows new primary and empty alternatives (old primary gone); (b) replace primary but include old primary in alternatives → NO audit line, saved file retains old primary as alt (agent's explicit choice respected). Both data states restored after verification.

Extends argparse via _add_semantic_flag_args() helper (the _add_flag_args was grandfathered at 10 lines so we delegate to a new helper). Flag flows through save_single_agent(strict_dedup=...) → _run_pre_save_checks → _run_cross_domain_dedup_check. Documented in --help text.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — pre-existing systematic state (see BA root_cause_analysis). Bugs 9/11/12 are semantic invariants the save layer never enforced.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Save layer was built field-correct (validation + merge_agent_slots) but had no semantic-level invariants. trip_total drifted when budget days were saved without re-aggregating; cross-domain duplicates accumulated unnoticed (Day 12 timeline.json carried both Huaihai-Wukang attraction and Wukang Road shopping for the same window); meal_slot primary replacement defaulted to whatever the agent submitted, with no audit of dropped primaries.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Three semantic invariants now enforced at the save layer: (1) on any budget save, trip_total is recomputed; (2) on any POI-flat save, cross-domain name collisions surface as WARN (or BLOCK with --strict-dedup); (3) on any meals save, primary replacements are audited and old primaries are dropped unless explicitly retained — making the agent's intent (preserve or drop) auditable instead of implicit.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: semantic_lint.py is a new module (287 lines) covering three independent semantic invariants (AC7/AC8/AC9), broken into single-purpose helpers to satisfy the project quality gate (max func 30 lines, max nesting 3, file <= 800 lines). save.py additions (~64 lines net) are mostly required by the gate's per-function 'no-worsen' rule: I couldn't grow existing functions, so I extracted thin wrappers (_translate_and_reject, _maybe_recompute_trip_total, _run_pre_save_checks, _run_cross_domain_dedup_check) instead of inlining. Without the gate constraints the same logic could land in ~150 lines.
